[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
The service catalogue records James Glasgow, ordinary seaman, Z/2612, born 24 September 1895.<ref>[https://discovery.nationalarchives.gov.uk/details/r/D7273068 The National Archives, ADM 339/1/14311: service record for James Glasgow].</ref> The medal roll lists him for the British War Medal.<ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/1687/records/1894550 The National Archives, ADM 171/126: Jas Glasgow, service number C Z/2612].</ref>

== Research Notes ==
The medal roll and service record catalogue identify the same sailor by number. James Sim Glasgow, born 24 September 1898 according to his current profile, is a possible comparison. The year differs, and the service catalogue gives no middle name or birthplace.
